name: Shiuchi Norikazu
source:
His parents have already passed away, and although he resolves to leave the town where he was born and raised to start a new life elsewhere,
he can’t stop thinking about Emika, his only childhood friend.
He asks Emika to leave town with him, but she refuses.
Immediately afterward, he is shocked to discover that she is in the arms of his stepfather,
but he manages to figure out her true intentions and takes her away.

Afterward, he swears that he’ll never let her go through that again and that the two of them will live happily together but...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013796.html/]dlsite[/url]]
